# Mifos Test Coverage Report

**Ground Truth:** `dataset/ground_truth/Mifos.md` (607 test cases across 32 modules)
**Generated Tests:** `results/Mifos/gpt-4o-mini/few_shot_per_module/test-cases.json` (155 test cases across 32 modules)
**Generated by:** openai/gpt-4o-mini | **Approach:** Few-Shot per Module | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered. Similarly, if the ground truth tests one dropdown and the generated tests test a different dropdown of the same type, that is still acceptable coverage.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

## Overall Findings

### Generated Tests Strengths & Weaknesses
The GPT-4o-Mini Few-Shot configuration is the worst performing approach tested. With **345 missing scenarios** and a **0.25 Ratio**, it highlights an important AI QA characteristic: providing strict few-shot examples to a smaller context-window model causes it to narrowly adhere to those examples rather than interpolating broad functional edge cases.
